reason: I only actually exercise when I'm in a class with other mums who notice if I don't turn up. A home program sits on my phone unused, so I might grab the free week but I doubt I'd pay for the full eight.
objection: It was made by a mum and only 'reviewed' by a physio, not designed by one, so I'm not sure it's safe for my tummy gap and pelvic floor, and doing it alone at home I'd have no one checking my form.
would_change_my_mind: If a women's health physio actually designed it and there was a live group session or a meetup with the other mums so I had real accountability.
